mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM wm_stock_document d JOIN wm_stock_document p ON p.id=d.paired_document_id WHERE d.id=#{id}
mapper.sql: FROM wm_stock_document d LEFT JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id=d.source_execution_id LEFT JOIN workorder o ON o.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id WHERE d.source_execution_id=#{executionId} AND d.status=#{postedStatus} AND d.document_type=#{productionReceiptType}

e.id IS NOT NULL AND o.id IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NOT NULL AND w.id IS NOT NULL AND o.source=#{localSource} AND w.source=#{localSource} AND e.product_id=o.product_id AND l.material_id=e.product_id AND l.unit_id=m.unit_id AND l.quantity>0 AND d.source_workorder_id IS NULL AND d.post_request_id IS NOT NULL AND d.post_request_hash IS NOT NULL AND d.posted_by IS NOT NULL AND d.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.execution_id=#{executionId} AND a.operation_id=d.post_request_id AND a.source_type=#{receiptSourceType} AND a.source_id=CONCAT('',d.id) AND a.action_type=#{receiptActionType} AND a.quantity_delta=l.quantity AND a.available_delta=l.quantity AND a.quantity_after-a.quantity_before=l.quantity AND a.available_after-a.available_before=l.quantity AND a.operator_user_id=d.posted_by AND a.request_hash=d.post_request_hash AND a.reference_action_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_action reversal WHERE reversal.reference_action_id=a.id) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_action duplicate_action WHERE duplicate_action.document_line_id=l.id)=1 AND a.stock_id=l.stock_id AND a.material_id=l.material_id AND a.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND a.unit_id=l.unit_id AND CAST(a.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(e.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND (a.bin_code=l.bin_code OR (a.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity),0) FROM ( SELECT l.quantity FROM wm_stock_document d JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.execution_id=d.source_execution_id WHERE d.source_execution_id=#{executionId} AND d.status=#{posted} AND d.document_type IN (#{receipt},#{productionReceipt}) UNION ALL SELECT quantity_delta FROM mes_warehouse_acceptance WHERE execution_id=#{executionId} ) f
